design_philosophy: Premium, minimal, modern. Bold streetwear aesthetic using stark contrasts, brutalist typography, and aggressive asymmetry. It should feel like a high-end streetwear drop (Nike SNKRS / Supreme vibes), not a generic dropshipping store.

rules.headings: Always tight tracking, uppercase for impact. Do not center everything; prefer stark left alignment with large margins.
rules.body: High readability, neutral colors (Zinc-400 for secondary).

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A: Tetris) for categories and lookbooks. Asymmetrical, masonry-style grids. Gap-4 to Gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.buttons: Large hit areas. py-4 px-8. Sharp edges (rounded-none).
spacing_and_layout.cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border (#27272A). No soft shadows. Use sharp, brutalist 1px borders.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism with extreme blur (backdrop-blur-2xl) but 0px radius. Fixed to top, z-50. Minimal links, massive logo. 1px bottom border.

hero.style: Full-bleed background image with bg-black/40 overlay. Massive typography (H1 'WEAR YOUR ATTITUDE') breaking standard grids. CTA is high-contrast white on black or red on white.
hero.features: Include a marquee or small mono-font trust badges at the absolute bottom of the hero.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-colors py-4 px-8 rounded-none border-none
buttons.accent: bg-[#FF3333] text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-red-600 transition-colors py-4 px-8 rounded-none
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 hover:border-white transition-all py-4 px-8 rounded-none
buttons.whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right corner. bg-[#25D366] text-white rounded-full p-4 shadow-lg hover:scale-110 transition-transform z-50

product_cards.style: Image-heavy. 1px border. Dark gray background. Title, price, and 'Buy Now' button appear boldly on hover.
product_cards.badges: Absolute positioned tags. Red for 'Limited Stock', White for 'Trending'. Mono font, small text, padding p-1 px-2.

marquee.style: Kinetic texture. Use react-fast-marquee. Massive outline text (text-8xl text-transparent border-white/10 style) in the background for offers.

modals_drawers.style: Use Shadcn Sheet for Cart Drawer. Use Shadcn Dialog for Size Guide. Sharp corners, dark overlay.

motion_and_interactions.hover: High contrast shifts. Images should scale up slightly (scale-105) on hover within an overflow-hidden container.
motion_and_interactions.libraries: framer-motion for page transitions and staggering. lenis for momentum scrolling.

hero_background.description: Main hero background, dark atmospheric streetwear model with sunglasses.

product_bestseller_2.description: Model with printed graphic oversized t-shirt.

texture_overlay.description: Black grunge texture for offer banner backgrounds.

specific_features.whatsapp_integration: Include a sticky WhatsApp icon (Lucide or react-icons) linked to 'https://wa.me/9810153152'. Color #25D366.
specific_features.trust_badges: Place below the Hero and on the Product Page. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide (e.g., Truck for free shipping, CurrencyInr for COD, ArrowUUpLeft for Returns).
specific_features.exit_intent_popup: 10% OFF discount code 'CYNOS10'. Dark dialog with a sharp red accent button.
specific_features.urgency_timers: Product page should have a 'Sale ends in XX:XX:XX' red mono text.
specific_features.social_proof: A small floating toast at bottom-left corner 'Rahul from Delhi just bought an Anime Tee' - use Framer Motion for entrance.
specific_features.sticky_buy_now: On mobile, Product page must have a sticky bottom bar with price and 'Buy Now' button.

testing.data_test_attributes: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='hero-shop-button', data-testid='add-to-cart-btn', data-testid='whatsapp-chat-btn'). Use kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the website using React + TailwindCSS + Shadcn UI.
Ensure all Shadcn components (Cards, Dialogs, Sheets, Buttons) are heavily modified to remove rounded corners (use rounded-none) to match the brutalist streetwear aesthetic.
Do NOT use generic standard fonts. Use Anton for H1/H2 (add via Google Fonts in index.html/App.css) and Manrope for body text.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide React for UI iconography.
Add 'framer-motion' for all micro-interactions (hover reveals, dialog open animations).
For the 'Buy 2 Get 1 Free' banner, use 'react-fast-marquee' with a scrolling text layer over the dark texture image.
Do NOT use placeholder images from via.placeholder.com. Use ONLY the URLs provided in the image_urls section.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind grids for the Bento-style category sections. Do not rely on Shadcn cards for complex marketing layouts.
Data structure for products should include standard e-commerce fields (id, name, price, original_price, images, category, badges, description). Mock this data elegantly.
Ensure the UI defaults to DARK mode and the background is strictly #050505 or #0A0A0A.
